correctness.rationale: For separately evaluated entrant sites A/B, S_A-S_B=t sum_i p_i(u_i-v_i)/[(1+t u_i)(1+t v_i)], denominator positive for t>0. Clearing denominators gives degree <=2m-2 polynomial, unless identical capture. With opposite local preferences in m=2, numerator is t(c0+c1 t+c2 t^2), c0=A0-B0, c1=A0(u2+v2)-B0(u1+v1), c2=A0u2v2-B0u1v1. Vieta and strict discriminant prove two preference reversals iff c0c2>0, c1c2<0 and c1^2>4c0c2. Boundary ties and identical quadratic handled. Independent exact Fraction checks at p=(1,5), u,v=(9,1,2,3) give thresholds 1/3,3 and gaps at t=1/6,1,6 of 17/420,-1/60,306/95095. Algebraic planar squared-distance computations verify a genuine inverse-square spatial witness. These finite checks corroborate, not replace, the root proof.

value.rationale: A two-zone, two-site market is the least model capable of a genuine double ranking reversal; the exact, open strict-inequality phase and planar realization distinguish robust nonmonotone comparative statics from an artifact of arbitrary nonspatial coefficients. This is a narrow but motivated constructive location-analysis fact, not a claim to a new Huff model or optimizer.
